scenarios.title: getPublicProfile retrieves public profile via user model method
scenarios.risk: Calling lean() returns a plain JavaScript object without model instance methods, causing callers relying on prototype methods to throw runtime errors.
scenarios.expectedBehaviorOnBase: Calling getPublicProfile(userId) obtains the User document from getUser and successfully calls user.toPublicProfile(), returning { id, displayName }.
scenarios.howChangeMayViolateIt: Because getUser now appends .lean(), it returns a POJO lacking Mongoose document methods, causing user.toPublicProfile() to throw a TypeError: user.toPublicProfile is not a function.

evidence.note: getPublicProfile expects getUser to return an object with the toPublicProfile method
getUser is modified to return findById(userId).lean() instead of the document instance

assumptions: getUser returns a user model instance with a toPublicProfile method on BASE
toPublicProfile maps the user's id and name to id and displayName
scenarios.testsWhat: Verifies that getPublicProfile returns the public profile generated by calling the toPublicProfile method on the User model document.
